{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Identify the highest sample_seq per patient to keep only the latest
latest_per_patient = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Compute response rate per site
counts = latest_per_patient.groupby('site')['responded'].agg(['count', 'sum'])
counts['response_rate'] = counts['sum'] / counts['count']

# Sort by response rate descending
response_rates = counts['response_rate'].sort_values(ascending=False)

# Extract the top site
highest_site = response_rates.index[0]
highest_rate = response_rates.iloc[0]

# Confirm the number of sites
unique_sites = df['site'].unique()

# Print final report
print(f"Unique sites in data: {unique_sites}")
print(f"Highest response rate: {highest_rate:.6f} at site {highest_site}")"}
